features.note: The facade word sign, room plates and complete-network overview preserve the multiplex identity, but surface wayfinding is sparse and the required corridor frame-1 labels-on capture is largely hidden by oversized gray/black planes.

The Sala 3 frame swap is visibly abstract-safe, but the view shows little acoustic-panel rhythm, no convincing carpet pattern, weak aisle/portal detailing and a large foreground slab that hides much of the room; the three auditorium families are not surface-legible from this set.

The Cinemex word sign and SNACKS/COMBOS menu change read selectively, but lobby, concessions and kitchen remain mostly flat massing. The concessions frame-1 capture is heavily occluded, and POS, snack-machine, floor-joint and kitchen-service cues are not convincingly visible.

The complete-network and UG67 engineering views preserve distinct green bus, blue network media, endpoint labels and the external chain. Close labels are readable, though BUS D/UC-D/TC05 cards dominate their equipment and direction/terminal cues need a clearer surface treatment.

Opaque architecture and translucent engineering states remain distinct, and labels-off is visibly suppressible. However, the frame-1 labels-on corridor state becomes unusable because enormous surface planes occlude the scene, so the required state pair is not coherently preserved across captures.

important_features.note: People, doors and the UG67 remain plausibly scaled, but several floating label cards are visually much larger than the devices they identify.

This surface gate is not judged as final lighting; within that limit, red/white public zones and dark auditoriums separate, but flat white expanses and blocked evidence views reduce surface readability.
Engineering routes and roof-service runs remain visible, but terminals, arrowheads, curb/flashing seams and service markings are too sparse to make containment consistently explicit.

defects: The corridor frame-1 labels-on image is mostly covered by huge gray and black surface planes while the labels-off image from the same view is clear; the required surface state changes visible scene coverage instead of only changing or suppressing labels.
The concessions frame-1 image is similarly blocked by a large black foreground plane, leaving only fragments of COMBOS menus readable and preventing a coherent frame-0/frame-1 comparison.

Facade panels are separated mainly by uniform dark lines on flat white faces; concrete and painted surfaces lack scale-appropriate low-frequency breakup, so the grazing view still reads as clean blockout material.
The glass entrance has readable mullions and pull handles, but no clear safety-band treatment and almost no differentiated door hardware or threshold surface detail.

Sala 3 shows an abstract red/yellow-to-cyan/white screen change, but a large gray foreground slab hides the lower half, the carpet is nearly solid purple, acoustic-panel rhythm is weak, and the floating 'WC VOID' card is inappropriate room content.

Auditorium portals and corridor doors lack convincing perimeter seals, consistent room plates and coordinated exit/service markings; small red headers and isolated green signs do not yet form a readable wayfinding system.
Roof-service surfaces are long flat dark bars with only a few thin roof lines and yellow end blocks; curb flashing, roof seams, service identifiers and containment transitions do not read.
The kitchen evidence view is dominated by oversized BUS D, UC-D and TC05 cards over plain slabs, so stainless workline, extraction, cabinet, POS and service-surface cues are not demonstrated.

The abstract poster/menu atlas is crisp and protected-content-safe, but the same two-card motif and three-line menu treatment repeat conspicuously across screens and rooms, making the reuse look templated rather than authored for each surface class.
corrections: Fix the frame-1 and labels-on surface planes so every label, menu and poster stays bounded to its intended target; re-capture concessions and corridor frame 0/frame 1 from identical cameras with no new occluding geometry or giant black/gray planes.
Keep the accepted building, material palette, endpoint counts, network routes and state queries unchanged while correcting only surface planes, atlas regions, label sizing and evidence framing.

Add scale-correct procedural facade breakup: preserve the readable word sign, introduce restrained panel/concrete variation and coherent joint widths, and add a clear glazing safety band plus visible pull/lock/threshold cues.

Rebuild the auditorium surface set with visible acoustic-panel rhythm, portal perimeter seals, consistent room-number plates, exit/service markings, aisle marks and a subtle non-tiling carpet pattern; remove the 'WC VOID' card and frame Sala 3 without the foreground slab hiding the floor and seating.

Give lobby and concession floors readable tile joints, and add distinct abstract-safe POS/snack/menu surface cues with controlled variation so frame changes remain obvious without repeating the same card treatment everywhere.

Reframe the kitchen surface evidence to show the stainless workline, extraction/containment and cabinet/service markings; reduce BUS D, UC-D and TC05 cards to target-relative sizes so they identify rather than cover their devices.
Add roof seam, curb/flashing edge and service/containment markings at believable scale, keeping the existing roof geometry and service routing intact.
Add restrained terminal marks and direction arrowheads to the existing green and blue network media, preserving every canonical endpoint and link path while improving close-view readability.

mechanical.note: All 14 capture sidecars are clean; 191 draws and 29,396 tris are within the 550-draw/750,000-triangle budget. SwiftShader fps is informational only.
